title: Microsoft Teams: desk utilisation analytics in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, desk licensing requirements and documented configuration commands are supported. Minor corrections would complete the licence-assignment path and make the remaining licensing disagreement and checklist-to-table gaps explicit.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The Places licensing page lists the paid Shared Space licence at $8 per desk per month.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams Shared Space (MTSS) | $8 per desk per month*

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The single-space licence is priced at $0.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams Shared Space Single Space (MTSSS) | $0 | A free sub-SKU, three per paid license.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; rationale: cost
claims.claim: One paid licence entitles the customer to three single-space licences.
claims.quote: The entitlement ratio is fixed at one paid license to three single-space licenses.

claims.claim: The Places page gives an effective desk rate of about $2 per desk per month.
claims.quote: Effective desk rate | About $2 per desk per month*

claims.claim: The prices shown exclude applicable taxes, fees and other charges.
claims.quote: License costs shown do not include applicable taxes, fees, or other charges, which may vary by region and billing terms.

claims.claim: Single-space licences are not provisioned automatically and must be actively acquired.
claims.quote: The three single-space licenses are not generated or provisioned automatically. Purchasing the paid license creates the entitlement; you must then actively acquire the single-space licenses yourself.
claims.fix: Keep the acquisition instruction, and add: 'The Teams Shared Space licensing page instead says that when a Shared Space licence is provisioned for a desk or BYOD room, the admin will see three additional $0 Single Space licences; the Places page explicitly says to acquire them yourself.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/teams-add-on-licensing/teams-shared-device-license.

claims.claim: The single-space desk licences are for desks rather than Teams devices.
claims.quote: Single-space desk licenses are intended only for desks and should not be assigned to Teams devices such as panels or common area phones.

claims.claim: The Places licensing page documents buying licences through Marketplace in the Microsoft 365 admin center for MCA customers.
claims.quote: This purchase path applies to organizations with a Microsoft Customer Agreement (MCA). Both licenses are available from the Microsoft Teams Shared Space listing in Marketplace.

claims.claim: The Marketplace purchase route requires billing account administrator or billing profile contributor permissions.
claims.quote: Billing account administrator or billing profile contributor permissions. Without them the Marketplace section of the Microsoft 365 admin center will not appear at all, and no order can be placed.

claims.claim: The Places page tells EA customers to use the Volume Licensing Center instead of Marketplace.
claims.quote: If your organization has an Enterprise Agreement (EA), use the Volume Licensing Center instead of the Marketplace purchase flow.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: conflicting MCA statement
claims.claim: The Teams Shared Space licensing page separately says Single Space is only available for purchase with an MCA billing account.
claims.quote: the Single Space license is only available for purchase with an MCA billing account.

claims.quote: Question: What do I need to access usage reports? Answer: These reports are currently in preview and don't require a license to access.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: unreconciled reporting entitlement

claims.quote: Searched: Teams desk utilization analytics 570648 default enabled switch pricing meter preview Desks usage report. Opened bookable-desks, teams-shared-device-license and Places desk licensing; read MC1490906. No passage reconciles preview report access with this rollout's desk licensing.

claims.claim: No separate analytics meter is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams desk utilization analytics dedicated enable disable default pricing consumption meter. Opened Teams Shared Space licensing, Places desk licensing and bookable-desks; they document per-space licences, not a separate analytics meter.

claims.claim: Learn describes both individual desks and desk pools.
claims.quote: Step 2 - Create Desk Pool or Individual Desk Accounts

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends individual desks for more detailed utilisation analytics.
claims.quote: Microsoft recommends setting up individual desks over desk pools for a better bookable desk user experience, more detailed utilization analytics, and more management capabilities.

claims.claim: Automatic peripheral association is supported only for individual desks.
claims.quote: The other approach is to wait for Teams Rooms Pro Management portal to associate the peripheral automatically. ... This approach is only supported for individual desks at this time.

claims.claim: Importing a prepared PERIPHERALS file can update desk-peripheral associations.
claims.quote: Save the CSV file in .XLSX format. The first sheet in the CSV file must be titled PERIPHERALS. ... Verify that the device and desk association is updated successfully in the Teams Pro Management portal.

claims.claim: Desk licences are assigned through Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > desk account > Assign licenses.
claims.quote: expand Users and select Active users. ... select it to open its details. Choose Assign licenses, select Microsoft Teams Shared Space, and save.
claims.fix: Complete controls[0].ui.path as 'Users > Active users > desk account > Assign licenses > Microsoft Teams Shared Space'; retain the same docs URL. The note may state: 'For a single-space licence, select Microsoft Teams Shared Space - Single instead.'

claims.claim: Connect-Graph with User.ReadWrite.All and Organization.Read.All followed by Set-MgUserLicense with UserId, AddLicenses and empty RemoveLicenses assigns licences.
claims.quote:
Connect-Graph -Scopes User.ReadWrite.All, Organization.Read.All
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $user -AddLicenses $addLicenses -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: BYOD Rooms and Desk management is reached in the portal under Settings > General.
claims.quote: BYOD Rooms and Desk management: This setting option is located under the General tab in Teams Pro Management portal. Bookable-desks also states: 'Settings > General'.

claims.claim: No API for the portal's BYOD Rooms and Desk management ingestion setting is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro Management BYOD Rooms Desk management cloud ingestion setting PowerShell Microsoft Graph API. Opened bring-your-own-device and bookable-desks; results document the portal option and separate client policy, not an API for the portal option.

claims.claim: The portal's BYOD Rooms and Desk management setting is enabled by default.
claims.quote: This feature is currently enabled by default, but admins have the option to disable it with this function.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; rendered portal-role row
claims.claim: Portal-specific role assignment starts at Settings > Roles > role > Assignments > Add assignment.
claims.quote: expand Settings > Roles. Select the role you want to assign. In the role pane, select Assignments > Add assignment.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no automation API for portal-specific role assignments.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro Management portal specific role assignments API PowerShell automation. Opened rooms-pro-rbac. Results describe portal assignments and separate Entra directory-role automation, not automation for portal-specific roles.

claims.claim: Creating or editing portal roles requires Global Administrator, Teams Administrator or Teams Rooms Pro Manager.
claims.quote: To create, edit, or assign roles, your account must have one of the following permissions: Global Administrator or Teams Administrator through Microsoft Entra ID. Teams Rooms Pro Manager through the Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal.

claims.claim: Assigning portal roles also permits a custom role with role management permissions.
claims.quote: To assign roles, you must be a Global Administrator/ Teams Administrator or Teams Rooms Pro Manager role or have a custom role with role management permissions.

claims.claim: Peripheral inventory imports are under Planning > Inventory > Devices > Import in the portal.
claims.quote: Sign in and open the Microsoft Teams Pro Management portal, on the Planning > Inventory > Devices page, select Import to add the device inventory to upload the file you modified.

claims.claim: No API that sets desk-peripheral associations is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams bookable desks peripheral association Microsoft Graph API PowerShell import PERIPHERALS. Opened get-peripheral-information and bookable-desks; read desk resource reference search result. No association-write API appeared; the script collects data for a portal import.

claims.claim: Get-TeamsBYODSpaceDevices.ps1 is a downloaded script run from its directory to collect peripheral information.
claims.quote: download the Get-TeamsBYODSpaceDevices.ps1 PowerShell script. ... Open a new PowerShell window and navigate to the location where you moved the Get-TeamsBYODSpaceDevices.ps1 script.

claims.claim: No admin UI for the Teams client's DeviceDataCollection policy is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams admin center DeviceDataCollection TeamsBYODAndDesksPolicy UI setting. Opened bookable-desks and bring-your-own-device; read Teams settings and policies reference results. No UI route for this client policy was returned.

claims.claim: Set-CSTeamsBYODAndDesksPolicy -Identity <name> -DeviceDataCollection Enabled and Grant-CSTeamsBYODAndDesksPolicy -PolicyName <name> -Identity <user> set and assign the collection policy.
claims.quote:
Set-CSTeamsBYODAndDesksPolicy -Identity Test -DeviceDataCollection Enabled
Grant-CSTeamsBYODAndDesksPolicy -PolicyName Test -Identity testuser@test.onmicrosoft.com

claims.claim: The collection policy requires MicrosoftTeams module 6.5.0 or later.
claims.quote: First, ensure that your Microsoft Teams module is on version 6.5.0 or higher.

claims.claim: The collection policy is off by default for government clouds.
claims.quote: For government clouds, this policy is off by default.

claims.claim: No UI for setting tenant enableBuildings is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Places enableBuildings building visibility admin portal UI setting. Opened quick-setup-buildings-floors and Set-PlacesSettings; read Places Administration Web App and Administration Portal results. They describe hierarchy management, not a UI for enableBuildings.

claims.claim: Set-PlacesSettings -EnableBuildings 'Default:true' enables tenant building visibility.
claims.quote: Set-PlacesSettings [-EnableBuildings] ... ['Default:True'] ... This parameter controls whether users can see buildings in Work plans, Workplace presence, Places finder, and other parts of the Microsoft Places experience.

claims.claim: Get-PlacesSettings -ReadFromPrimary reads current tenant Places settings.
claims.quote:
This example returns the up-to-date Places features configured on your tenant.
Get-PlacesSettings -ReadFromPrimary

claims.claim: Get-PlacesSettings requires either Exchange Admin or Places TenantPlacesManagement.
claims.quote: You must have either the Exchange Admin role or the Places TenantPlacesManagement role.

claims.claim: Set-PlacesSettings requires both Exchange MailRecipients and Places TenantPlacesManagement.
claims.quote: You must have both the Exchange MailRecipients role and the Places TenantPlacesManagement role.

claims.claim: Buildings are not visible across Microsoft Places experiences by default.
claims.quote: By default, buildings are not visible across Microsoft Places experiences (Work plans, Workplace presence, Places cards, and so on).

claims.where: controls[6].ui and api; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No dedicated UI or API switch for the new Teams portal desk analytics is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams desk utilization analytics dedicated enable disable default pricing consumption meter. Opened bookable-desks, bring-your-own-device and Set-PlacesSettings. No dedicated switch for this Teams portal release was documented; Places SpaceAnalyticsEnabled concerns Places analytics.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Open questions
claims.claim: The new analytics' default state on arrival is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams desk utilization analytics 570648 default enabled switch pricing meter preview Desks usage report; Teams Rooms Pro Management analytics desk preview 570648 rollout default reports. Read roadmap, MC1490906 and bookable-desks; prerequisites are stated, not this release's default.

claims.claim: Desk analytics entitlement uses an add-on Shared Space licensing model.
claims.quote: You purchase one paid Microsoft Teams Shared Space (MTSS) license, and that purchase entitles you to three Microsoft Teams Shared Space Single Space (MTSSS) licenses priced at zero.

claims.claim: The cited licence-assignment PowerShell article covers Teams add-on licences generally rather than naming Shared Space.
claims.quote: Add-on licenses are licenses for specific Teams capabilities like Audio Conferencing, Teams Phone, and Calling Plans. This article describes how to assign add-on licenses to individual users and large sets of users in bulk.

claims.claim: The roadmap and supplied notice describe admin analytics, not a change for people booking desks.
claims.quote: We're expanding analytics in the Microsoft Teams Pro Management portal to include utilization insights for bookable desks. IT admins will be able to better understand how desk spaces are being used across their organization

claims.claim: Learn documents CSV export for the Desks usage report.
claims.quote: Export desk usage details metrics as a csv file.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; controls table
claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to check the Desks usage report, but the controls table has no report-access row.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'Check the Desks usage report for desks with no data'. The seven control rows cover licensing, cloud ingestion, portal roles, peripheral association, client policy, enableBuildings and a dedicated-switch gap; none gives report navigation.
claims.fix: The After rollout step 'Check the Desks usage report' has no corresponding report-access row. Remove that checklist bullet; retain the existing report description in What's changing. Do not add a control row in this correction.

claims.claim: The checklist asks readers to review Entra roles with portal access, but the table's role row is expressly limited to portal-specific assignments.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'Review who holds Teams Rooms Pro Manager, Site Lead and the Entra roles with portal access'. Table row: 'Portal-specific role assignments'.
claims.fix: The Before rollout instruction to review Entra roles has no matching control row. Narrow the existing step to 'Review who holds Teams Rooms Pro Manager and Site Lead, and add portal roles through Settings > Roles > role > Assignments > Add assignment where needed.' Keep the factual Entra role-access discussion in Risk assessment.
